newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Oil shows recorded in Philippine well.
newsitem.headline: Oil shows recorded in Philippine well.

text.p: The Philippine National Oil Co.-Exploration Corp. recorded "rare to weak" oil shows at its third well in Maniguin, Mindoro in northern Visayas over the weekend.

Ismael U. Ocampo, Department of Energy oil and gas chief said that PNOC-EC-led consortium will reach its target depth of 7,200 feet within the week. Ocampo said PNOC-EC hopes to flow more than 180 barrels of oil per day in this well spudded on August 15.

Members of the consortium include Oriental Petroleum & Minerals Corp, Dragon Far East Ltd, Petrofields Exploration & Development Co Inc, Asian Petroleum & Minerals Inc., Basic Petroleum & Minerals Inc, and Southwest Resources.

"The oil and gas shows are a normal occurence as this well is only three kilometers away from the second well which flowed 180 barrels of oil per day when it was tested last year," PNOC-EC vice-president Lucio Samonte said.
